title: before review, check that every landed-changed path named in an owner decision is modified in the diff, and flag it if not

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-144738-d085, project ork, item S558:

before review, check that every landed-changed path named in an owner decision is modified in the diff, and flag it if not

Evidence: the owner decision names landed-changed/S548.md, but the diff touches only landed-changed/S558.md

sections.body:

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: `TestDecisionPathsReviewerBrief`: a reviewer brief flags missing changelog paths from spec answers, run answers, slice owner-decision paragraphs and cited adj records. Modifying the named path removes the warning; an unrelated change does not. Multiple paths are sorted and listed once. Failed reads produce advisory notices. The check never blocks the run.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Owner decisions (2026-11-25): How should S560 be specified before an implementer starts? -> rule: a deterministic engine step that runs after the implementer hands off and before the reviewer starts. It scans the run's decisions (adj records the slice cites, plus the owner answers recorded for the run) for `landed-changed/<ID>.md` paths. Any path not in the branch diff against the base is added to the reviewer's brief as a flagged finding. It does not block the run. [relay.landed-changed-path-check].

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria: the reviewer brief flags missing changelog paths named in spec answers, run answers, slice owner-decision paragraphs and cited adj records. Modifying the named path removes the warning; an unrelated change does not. Multiple paths are sorted and listed once. Failed reads produce advisory notices. The check never blocks the run.
